definitions.gloss: excellent, very good, couldn't be better
definitions.explanation: Describes a result or outcome that meets or exceeds expectations. Often used when evaluating performance, results, or progress, with a tone of satisfaction.

examples.japanese: {滑|すべ}り{出|だ}しは{上々|じょうじょう}だ。
examples.english: We're off to an excellent start.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}のプレゼンの{出来|でき}は{上々|じょうじょう}だった。
{新商品|しんしょうひん}の{売|う}れ{行|ゆ}きは{上々|じょうじょう}で、{予想|よそう}を{上回|うわまわ}る{結果|けっか}となった。
examples.english: Sales of the new product have been excellent, exceeding expectations.

notes:
{上々|じょうじょう} is a reduplication of {上|じょう} (upper, good) and conveys strong satisfaction with an outcome.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出来|でき}は{上々|じょうじょう} (the result is excellent)
- {滑|すべ}り{出|だ}しは{上々|じょうじょう} (off to an excellent start)
- {売|う}れ{行|ゆ}きは{上々|じょうじょう} (sales are going very well)
- {成績|せいせき}は{上々|じょうじょう} (grades/results are very good)
- {上々|じょうじょう}の{仕上|しあ}がり (an excellent finish)

USAGE NOTES:
- Most commonly used as a predicate: 〜は{上々|じょうじょう}だ
- Implies the result exceeded what was merely acceptable
- Has a somewhat mature or evaluative tone; less casual than すごい or いい
